name: From Procrastination to Action
equipment: A notebook and one delayed task
instructions: Pick the task you have been avoiding longest and write down the smallest possible first step.
Set a 10-minute timer and commit to just that first step -- you can stop after, but most people keep going once started.
Reward yourself (a short break, a coffee) immediately after taking action, to build a positive association with starting.
Watch today's video, then apply it to your own delayed task right after.
